key_points: Rep. Jonathan Jackson's disclosed EL purchase is a mildly positive insider signal, but congressional buys of this size are weak evidence and do not move the thesis
Miami airport travel-retail boutique with Duty Free Americas (Le Labo, Tom Ford Beauty, Jo Malone) is an incremental prestige distribution win, not material to group sales
Headlines on Starwood insider buying, El Paso, InRetail Peru and El Salvador are ticker/name mismatches unrelated to Estée Lauder
Simply Wall St insider-ownership list and quote-page items are generic commentary with no new fundamental information
No earnings, guidance, or regulatory news in the window, so EL's view hinges on the ongoing turnaround in China/travel retail and margin recovery rather than these items
